title: CmdPal: Prevent event subscriptions after item cleanup
author: jiripolasek
summary: The new CmdPal lifecycle race report is already covered by an upstream PR from the assignee, so the dashboard should point maintainers at the in-flight fix instead of starting parallel design work.

judgment.rationale: The issue was filed by the assignee together with an immediately linked upstream PR that closes the report and updates the exact lifecycle and subscription files named in the bug.
evidence: Issue #50484 was opened on 2026-09-09 against current main/dev builds and assigned to jiripolasek at creation time.
The issue body names a race where CommandItemViewModel initialization can finish after cleanup and still subscribe to events.
Open upstream PR #50487, "CmdPal: Fix item subscription races during cleanup (part 1)", closes #50484 and was updated minutes after the issue.
PR #50487 changes CommandItemViewModel, CommandContextItemViewModel, CommandViewModel, ExtensionPropertySubscription, ListItemViewModel, and dedicated lifecycle unit tests.
judgment.recommended_action: Track PR #50487 as the canonical fix attempt and avoid duplicate dashboard design work for this issue.

fix_assessment.rationale: An active upstream PR from the current assignee already targets the named race and adds focused lifecycle coverage.

issue_context.summary: A CmdPal maintainer reported that item view models can finish initialization after cleanup and retain event subscriptions that should have been torn down.
known_information: The report targets Command Palette on main/dev builds and identifies the failing class family directly.
The issue is assigned to jiripolasek.
The automated triage comment asking for more repro steps was minimized as resolved.
PR #50487 is already linked as the closing change.
inferences: This is an engineer-filed code-path bug rather than an end-user symptom report, so the missing end-user repro details do not block action.
Because the linked PR changes both lifecycle code and tests, the maintainer work is already underway in the right layer.
issue_context.analysis: The public dashboard should show this as handled by linked work. Starting a second design would duplicate the assignee’s active PR instead of improving issue coverage.
initial_investigation: PR #50487 body explicitly says initialization and cleanup can race and cause late event subscriptions after cleanup.
The PR file list includes new CommandItemViewModel lifecycle unit tests, which is the expected coverage for this bug class.

Current main already contains cleanup/unsubscribe logic in src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.ViewModels/CommandItemViewModel.cs, so the issue is about a newly identified edge case, not a missing owner.
